prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body dream couture portrait of one approved adult woman in a gown formed from floating flower petals in a softly lit studio.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark wavy shoulder-length hair, peaceful smile, natural skin texture, and a floral haute couture gown constructed from layered pastel petals, blossoms, leaves, and airy floating floral elements. Nude-toned pointed heels are visible beneath the gown.
composition_elements: Full-body subject centered in a gentle mid-step pose with arms slightly open.
Petal-gown train flows diagonally toward the floor and loose petals orbit through the air.
Soft light-gray studio background with warm circular light bokeh and scattered petals on the floor.
Keep floral material, face, gown silhouette, shoes, and motion readable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio light with luminous pastel highlights, gentle shadows, airy atmosphere, and controlled warm bokeh without haze obscuring the subject.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full-body portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, realistic flowers, petals, leaves, skin, fabric, and floor texture, subtle natural grain, sharp face, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Dream couture portrait of one approved adult woman with dark wavy shoulder-length hair and a peaceful smile, wearing a full-length haute couture gown constructed from layered pastel flower petals, blossoms and leaves. She stands mid-step with gentle movement and arms slightly open, nude-toned pointed heels visible beneath the flowing floral train. Loose petals orbit through the air and scatter across the floor. Use a softly lit light-gray studio, luminous pastel highlights, warm circular bokeh, airy controlled atmosphere, 85mm lens, 4:5 full-body composition, realistic floral materials and natural skin texture, no text, no watermark.
